title: Structure class starting-equipment options
description: class.data.startingEquipment.entries are prose option lines, e.g. Fighter '(a) chain mail or (b) leather armor, longbow, and 20 arrows' and Wizard '(a) a quarterstaff or (b) a dagger'. They are not parsed into selectable (a)/(b) option groups, so the CLI cannot present a deterministic equipment choice without prose parsing. Fixed grants (e.g. 'A spellbook') are mixed into the same entries list.
acceptance_criteria: Parse startingEquipment into structured option groups (choose-one among labeled options, each option a list of item refs/quantities) plus fixed grants, in the importer; keep verbatim text. Regenerate via importer (docs/importer-fix-protocol.md) with audit coverage. Feeds the equipment/proficiency flow (b69j.13). Likely files: importers, kindSchemas.ts optStartingEquipment, rulesPackResolver.ts.
notes: PR #306 open for review: https://github.com/jbongaarts/eshyra/pull/306. Source-cited starting-equipment overlay (srdClassStartingEquipment.ts) keyed to frozen class keys; choose-one groups + fixed grants, each entry sourceText deep-equals pack startingEquipment.entries. requiredChoices emits structured equipment choices (choose:1, options in from); fixed grants auto-applied; non-overlay classes fall back to tracked prose. Rogue stray-(a) line modelled as fixed. No importer/frozen-pack files. verify:worktree green (2534 passed/19 skipped). Unblocks b69j.13.
